{{Short description|Russian mathematician (1866–1943)}}
[[File:Vissarion Aleksejev.jpg|thumb|Vissarion Alekseyev]]
'''Vissarion Grigorievich Alekseyev''' ([[Russian language|Russian]]: Виссарион Григорьевич Алексеев; 18 June 1866 – 1943) was a Russian mathematician. 1909-1914 and 1917–1918 he was the [[rector of Tartu University]].<ref name="ISIK">{{cite web |title=Aleksejev, Vissarion |url=https://galerii.kirmus.ee/biblioserver/isik/index.php?id=56 |website=kirmus.ee |access-date=6 February 2024}}</ref>

He was graduated from Moscow University. Since 1891 he worked at the [[Imperial University of Dorpat]].<ref name="ISIK" />

In 1920 he moved permanently to Estonia.<ref name="ISIK" />

He died in 1943 in Poland.<ref name="ISIK" />
